'''Bogstalkers''' were ancient creatures from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taris/Legends|Taris]]. Before the [[Jedi Civil War]], no one was able to see these creatures, but after [[Darth Malak]]'s [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|bombardment]], bogstalkers appeared again on the planet's devastated surface. They survived for hundreds of years beneath Taris's sprawling [[Undercity (Taris)|undercity]] and, during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], they could be seen flying around the planet's toxic [[Swamp/Legends|swamps]]. After its "rebirth", the pollution from Taris's destroyed industries made the bogstalkers more resilient and mutated their flesh, making them poisonous to most predators, even the voracious [[rakghoul]]s.
